user.title: Set up MQTT sharing
user.description: Sharing uses your existing MQTT connection. The receiver must receive discovery messages under the matching prefix. A dedicated sharing prefix prevents the sender from importing its own exports.

data.base_topic: Topic root for states and commands
data.use_remote_bridge: Connect a remote sharing broker over secure WebSockets

filters.title: Filter by area and type
filters.description:
For this round, choose lights, for example. Add switches or covers in another round. Areas and search narrow the results further. Your previous selections are kept.

entities.description:

Select multiple entities and press OK. You can then add more types or review your full selection. Nothing is shared until you save.

review.title: Review sharing and permissions
review.description:
**{selected} shared entities: {read} read-only · {control} controllable**

Manual selection grants sharing. The second field additionally allows control. In hybrid mode, exclusions override manual selection, which overrides labels. Label-based sharing updates automatically.

round.title: Selection collected — what next?
round.description:
**Collected: {summary}**

**{selected} entities in total.** You can now add switches after selecting lights, for example. Your previous selections are kept.

Select all / clear applies only to the {matches} results of the last filter.

menu_options.select_all: Select all matches in this round
menu_options.next_page: Show more matches in this round

mode.title: Choose a sharing mode
mode.description:
List: a fixed selection. Labels: automatic selection based on labels. Hybrid: labels plus manual permissions and exclusions. Received MQTT Share entities are never exported again.

Find received devices in the received-shares overview in MQTT Entity Share options; they remain in MQTT. The optional label grants no permissions. Turning it off removes only label assignments added automatically by this integration.

data.label_received: Automatically label received entities with “MQTT-Share received”

labels.title: Labels for this instance
labels.description: Choose existing labels or enter names for new labels. If an existing label is selected, the name field is ignored. New labels are created only on final save. Device labels apply to supported entities on that device. The control label wins when both labels apply.

bridge.title: Connect to the sharing broker
bridge.description: Your existing MQTT connection is kept. Only shares from this instance and the specified peer are relayed. TLS certificates are verified. WebSocket path: /mqtt. The local discovery prefix must match your existing MQTT integration.

error.invalid_topic: Use a dedicated discovery prefix without slashes and a valid topic root (not homeassistant).
error.invalid_entities: The selection contains unavailable or unsupported entities.
error.missing_label: This label no longer exists. Please select it again.
error.label_required: Select an existing label or enter a name.
error.same_label: Use different labels for reading and control.
error.invalid_peer: Enter a valid, distinct peer topic root and a valid peer source ID.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sharing is already configured. Open the options of the existing integration.
abort.invalid_selection: The selection has changed. Please reopen the dialog.
